messages:
dana: Quick preflight — putting the 23:00 UTC deploy on the calendar. Core ask: final release notes, internal announce copy, and pinning matrix. Canary will be model-v2.1.1-canary (10% traffic). We need rollback trigger and fallback plan (pin to model-v2.0.9 + read-only mode?).

matt: sgtm. I'll own the RN bulleted section. Can you paste the short RN blurb for the internal email?

jen: I'll handle the internal announcement and add the ops runbook. Need confirm of change window and who pings CSE.

dana: change window 22:55–23:30 UTC (hard stop 23:45). CSE notify: @oliver. Pin matrix: primary= model-v2.1.1, fallback= model-v2.0.9, degrade-mode=quantized-v2.0.9.

oliver: noted. I'll be on for rollback. If canary error rate > 2% or 5xx increase > 0.5pp we rollback. pref to automate via deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: /deploy start canary model=model-v2.1.1 canary=10% window=30m
Output:
```
[deploy] Starting canary rollout 1995551234
canary group: 10% traffic -> model-v2.1.1
watchers: @ops-oncall @oliver
timeout: 30m
```

matt: RN draft:
```
- Feature: improved context window handling for long prompts (model-v2.1.1)
- Fix: reduce KV cache thrashing on concurrent chat sessions
- Note: small perf regression in short prompt latency (~5%) — fallback to v2.0.9 recommended if observed
```

product-eng: copy for internal: "Deploying model-v2.1.1 tonight with 10% canary. Expect improved long prompt quality. SRE: watch latency and 5xx. Ops: rollback thresholds posted."

jen: pushing announce to slack #general + #customer-success at 23:05 UTC. I'll include rollback contact and short RN. cc: @dana

ops-oncall: I'll run the healthcheck script during canary. Paste of check:
```
./healthcheck.sh --env prod --model model-v2.1.1 --samples 100
```
If failures, escalate to @oliver then trigger `/deploy rollback 1995551234`.

sre-bot: Alert policy attached: latency_p95_increase > 10% for 5m -> page oncall.

dana: final call — any objections?

matt: none from me. :thumbsup:

oliver: no objections. I'll be standing by. :white_check_mark:

dana: ok launching the canary in 5. I'll post updates in this thread. Keep short messages only.

deploy-bot: /deploy status 1995551234
Output:
```
canary: running (5m elapsed)
error_rate: 0.7%
p95_latency: +3%
no pages
```

matt: looks healthy so far.

ops-oncall: healthcheck passed (0 failures)

dana: moving to 50% if no regressions in next 10m.

deploy-bot: /deploy promote 1995551234 -> 50%
Output:
```
promoted to 50%
```

sre-bot: NOTE: scheduled post-deploy metric snapshot to run +15m

jen: announce posted, sent to #all with RN and rollback instructions.

dana: thanks team. keeping thread open for 30m post-promote.
